slides.title: Your finance leader builds next year’s forecast from your widgets.
slides.headline: Your finance leader builds next year’s forecast from your widgets.
body: Before the annual, each leader gives the finance leader their own widget numbers.
Put a name on every line of the profit and loss.
notes: Finance builds the model. Each leader owns the numbers for their own widgets. The CEO owns the total. When the forecast is wrong, the first question is which widget moved, not who to blame.
The team already forecasts its widgets week by week. Next year’s forecast uses the same widgets, month by month.
Scan the code, then choose File and Make a copy in Google Sheets.
The forecast is not a budget. It shows where cash is heading.
Homework: the finance leader builds the 12-month forecast before the annual.

artwork.alt: One QR code. 12-month forecast: the finance leader builds next year in this. It opens the Example tab of the 12-month cash forecast template in Google Sheets.
